contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ VALEN S PF AVG ; R/ [GLORIA ROMANORVM]

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Valens (364-378), Emperor right, Reece period 19. Obverse description: Bust probably diademed, draped and cuirassed, right. Obverse inscription: VALEN S PF AVG. Reverse description: Emperor advancing right dragging captive and holding labarum. C CI in field. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA ROMANORVM]. In exergue: possibly [-]SOS. Diameter: 17.6mm, Weight: 1.64gms, die axis: 6
